why: Scores: base STR 15 DEX 14 CON 13 INT 12 WIS 10 CHA 8 plus Soldier (STR +2, CON +1) = STR 17 (+3), DEX 14 (+2), CON 14 (+2), INT 12 (+1), WIS 10 (0), CHA 8 (-1). Fighter 4 + Paladin 7 (Oath of Thunder), level 11, PB 2+(11-1)//4 = 4. Aura of Alacrity (Paladin 7) adds the proficiency bonus of the whole character (4) to Initiative: DEX 2 + 4 = 6. Aura of Protection (Paladin 6+) adds the CHA modifier (minimum +1; CHA is -1, so +1) to all saves: STR 3+4+1 = 8, CON 2+4+1 = 7, DEX 2+1 = 3, INT 1+1 = 2, WIS 0+1 = 1, CHA -1+1 = 0. HP: Fighter 12 + 3x8 = 36, Paladin d10 7x(6+2) = 56, total 92.
